description: An object of this type represents a single event.
An event has a key and a value
The key can consist of multiple integer or string fields, e.g.
job id, array task id, pe task id
The value represents the new version of data.
It can be a list of objects or an individual object
An event has a unique serial number.

attributes.name: unique_id
attributes.summary: unique ID for an event within qmaster.
description: A unique number. IDs are always increasing for generated events. No wrap around.
It is used in qmaster to synchronize activities between transaction processing happening
in different threads. Session table contains the biggest ID of the last RW request that
was handled in any thread for that session.

attributes.name: number
description: A unique serial number.
It is used to acknowledge receipt of a list of events
(up to a specific event represented by the serial number)
and also to detect inconsistencies in the event protocol, e.g. a missing event.

attributes.name: timestamp
description: Date and time (microseconds since epoch) when the event was generated.

attributes.name: type
description: The type of the event. Values of enumeration type ev_event (libs/sgeobj/sge_event.h), e.g.
- sgeE_ADMIN_HOST_LIST
- sgeE_ADMIN_HOST_ADD
- sgeE_ADMIN_HOST_DEL
- sgeE_ADMIN_HOST_MOD
- sgeE_CALENDAR_LIST

attributes.name: intkey
description: An int key for use by a specific event type, e.g. job id in a sgeE_JOB_ADD event.

attributes.name: intkey2
description: A second int key for use by a specific event type, e.g. ja_task id in a sgeE_JATASK_MOD event.

attributes.name: strkey
description: A string key for use by a specific event type, e.g. the complex variable name in a sgeE_CENTRY_DEL event.

attributes.name: strkey2
description: A second string key for use by a specific event type, e.g.
in a sgeE_QINSTANCE_ADD event the first key is the cluster queue name, the second key is the host name

attributes.name: new_version
description: A list containing the new object(s). The list type depends on the event type.
@todo we could split this into two fields, one for lists and one for individual objects
